text:
Sam (People Ops): Quick compact one-pager for new manager handoff + 30/60/90 template. Made it intentionally short so busy managers can copy/paste.

Priya: This looks super usable. Can you add explicit calendar times?

Sam (People Ops): Added a skeleton calendar and a tiny access checklist. Keep meetings brief on day 1.

Alex: Add a concrete access escalation path (who to DM if GitHub fails).

Sam (People Ops): Yep 12: @it-support for urgent, @infra-ops for cloud perms, cc me if its blocks.

Jordan: Recommend a daily 15min check-in for the first full week (or async standup for remote folks).

Taylor: Also include "who owns what" for manager vs buddy so responsibilities are crystal clear.

Sam (People Ops): Done. Posting final single-page below.

Sam (People Ops): ```
MANAGER PREP (week before) - ~30min
- Send welcome email with start logistics and buddy name
- Create access ticket: Okta, Slack, GitHub, Google Drive, cloud role
- Add to team Slack and onboarding docs
- Draft 3 top-level 90-day goals to share on day 1

DAY 1 (keep it light)
09:30 - 10:30 Manager 1:1: role clarity, goals, immediate priorities
11:00 - 11:30 Team kickoff: intros + org map (record for timezoneed folks)
14:00 - 14:30 Buddy session: env setup, run-first-app, first PR pair
16:30 - 16:45 Manager pulse: quick wrap & blockers

DAYS 2-5
10:00 - 10:15 Daily huddle (live or async) to surface blockers
Schedule 2 deep dives: product domain + infra/dev loop

WHO DOES WHAT
- Manager: goals, roadmap context, performance expectations, 30-day feedback
- Buddy: tooling, repo walkthrough, first PR pairing, quick answers
- People Ops: payroll, benefits, laptop/order follow-ups, ID/access escalation

ACCESS CHECK (quick)
- Okta group added and Slack invite sent
- GitHub org membership + team repo access
- Google Drive folders shared (onboarding + team)
- Cloud role (read) assigned; request write if needed
- Laptop: order placed or imaged. If provisioning fails DM @it-support + cc @Sam

30/60/90 (one-page to share)
- 30 days: orient  understand codebase, ship a small fix, meet cross-functional partners
- 60 days: own a small feature end-to-end, take on service familiarity, handle minor incidents
- 90 days: lead an end-to-end project, propose a perf/cost or quality improvement

WEEK 2 MANAGER CHECKPOINTS (3 bullets)
- Transfer ownership of a small task and set expectations for it
- Schedule a skip-level intro with manager's manager
- Provide 30-day feedback and align on next priorities

TEMPLATES
Manager welcome email:
"Hi {name}, welcome to Team X! Your buddy is {buddy}. We'll meet 9:30-10:30 on day 1 for orientation. I've attached three priority goals for your first 90 days. See you on {start_date}."

Slack intro post:
"Please welcome {name} to Team X as {role}! Buddy: {buddy}. Fun fact: {one-liner} :tada:"
```

Priya: Perfect. Can you also add a one-line note about timezone adjustments for distributed teams?

Sam (People Ops): Noted in the calendar section: record team kickoff and offer async standup option. I'll drop a PDF + MD in the onboarding repo and post link here shortly.

OnboardBot: Laptop provisioning: order created (ETA 3 business days).

Alex: Thanks team, will reuse for my new hire next week.

Sam (People Ops): Great! Ping me if you want a customized version for infra/product pods.
